PDF Splitter

Extract specific pages from a PDF. Type page ranges like 1-3, 5, 8-10 and get a new PDF containing exactly those pages, in your order.

Split PDF

Extract exactly the pages you want into a new PDF.

No file loaded yet.

Use single pages (5), ranges (1-3), or mix them with commas: 1-3, 5, 8-10.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file — its total page count appears once loaded.
  2. Type the pages you want, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10.
  3. Click "Extract pages" — invalid ranges show a clear error.
  4. The new PDF with only your chosen pages downloads automatically.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I write the page ranges?

Type single pages (5), ranges (1-3) and mix them with commas, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10. Pages are extracted in the order you list them.

Does splitting change my original PDF?

No. Splitting creates a brand-new PDF with only the pages you selected. Your original file is never modified.

Which page is page 1?

Page 1 is the first page of the document, counting up from there. The tool shows the total page count after you load a file.
